evals.name: dellm-ch11-pass
evals.prompt: Chapter 11 of System 3 (chapters/11-the-store-that-builds-itself.md) still feels like LLM writing to me. Do a de-LLM pass on it. Work on a copy: save the edited chapter as ch11.md, plus your change list and before/after measurements, in the outputs folder.
assertions: Change list gives before/after measurements compared against a baseline from the author's own chapters
Every cut or recast in the change list has a stated reason
No invented first-person experience, new facts or new claims added to the chapter
Jokes and the chapter's comic lines survive the pass (none cut or flattened)
The change list's claims about protected or restored lines are accurate (they match what the edited copy actually contains)

evals.name: dellm-xy-ch8
evals.prompt: Do an X/Y pass on chapter 8 of System 3 (chapters/08-automatic-alignment-research.md): remove the 'not X but Y' / 'X is not Y. It is Z' pattern where it's a tic, keep it where it does work. Work on a copy: save ch08.md and the change list in the outputs folder.
assertions: Change list lists the X/Y instances found, each with a cut-or-keep decision and a reason
At least one contrast is deliberately kept because it does argumentative work

evals.name: devedit-arc-review
evals.prompt: Review the arc of System 3 as it stands now (book order in book-design/curated/book-order.json). Before any edits, propose the spine back to me so I can correct it, and tell me where you're least sure. Report only; save it as arc-proposal.md.
assertions: States the book's spine in three sentences or fewer and explicitly offers it for correction
Has a 'least sure' section with at least three specific uncertainties, each tied to evidence in the book
Book order matches book-design/curated/book-order.json (reveal after Ch5, interlude between Ch8 and Ch9, Ch13 fable then coda)
Does not present already-resolved items (reveal ASSISTANT EDIT, interlude ASSISTANT DRAFT, Ch9 SLOT 4) as current open blockers
Treats Chapter 13 as protected: proposes no change to it
Report only: applies no edits and frames structural concerns as questions or proposals
